name: web-estimated-arrival-card-with-orange-progress-outline-and-free-tag
title: White card 'ESTIMATED ARRIVAL September 28, Friday delivery' with an orange clock, an orange border that fills as progress and a Free pill
whatItIs: A white card with a rounded orange outline that runs along the top and left edges as a progress trace, an orange clock icon, a small caps label, a bold navy date, a grey line, an orange gradient 'Free' pill and a small chevron.
whatItMeans: Clear and reassuring; the orange outline turns a delivery estimate into a subtle progress cue.
techniques: Use the card border as a progress line.
Pair a clock icon with the date.
Show cost in a small pill.

vocabulary.definition: An outline that fills to show progress.
A tiny caps label above the main text.
